decision.observation: Car at 4 mph, sitting slightly right of centre with a blue puddle under its right flank; a large puddle on the left of the lane and more up-screen. Lane bends left then eases right toward the lit gantry area at top. Red X lit, dots dark.
decision.hypothesis: Plain throttle keeps nudging the car right in this stretch, and the lane bends left, so a short throttle-left hold should hold the bend and recentre without scrubbing much speed.
decision.memory: W+A 0.5s previously produced a clean centred result at 2 mph; that combination is the workhorse for left bends in puddle fields.
